title: Red Hat Security Advisory: python-oauthlib security update
description: A security vulnerability in python-oauthlib was identified that allows privilege escalation due to client identity confusion in token grant handlers. This issue affects Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10 and has been addressed by an update to python-oauthlib version 3.2.2-6.el10_3.1. The vulnerability is rated as having important security impact by Red Hat Product Security.
